tool.text: check_file Validate an approved local CSV or Parquet dataset for missing values (nulls) and duplicate rows. Use for data-quality checks, RAG ingestion preparation or evaluation dataset validation when these checks are sufficient. Returns bounded aggregate check results; quality failures are successful tool executions, not transport errors. Runs locally with explicit directory consent; no raw values are returned or uploaded. Does not edit data, accept custom schema/rules, judge RAG answer quality or certify compliance. 데이터 품질: 승인된 로컬 CSV·Parquet의 결측값과 중복 행 검사.

profile_file Profile an approved local CSV or Parquet dataset before analysis, RAG ingestion or evaluation. Use to inspect column types and aggregate statistics, including null counts. Returns a bounded summary with truncation indicators, without sample/raw values. Runs locally with explicit directory consent and does not upload or edit data. Inferred types are observations, not validation against a supplied schema; no charts or semantic RAG evaluation. 데이터 프로파일링: 승인된 로컬 파일의 열 타입·집계 통계.

scan_pii Scan an approved local CSV or Parquet dataset for likely PII (sensitive personal data). Use for sensitive-data screening before RAG ingestion or sharing an evaluation dataset. Returns bounded finding summaries and sampled count estimates, never matched raw values. Runs locally with explicit directory consent and does not upload or edit data. Sampling can miss PII; a clean scan is not proof of absence or a legal compliance determination. Not cloud DLP or redaction. 개인정보·민감정보 탐지: 표본 기반 로컬 검사.
